policy.selection: Fixed actual chosen model/format, never fixture ID, source case, expected answer or model prediction.
policy.actualWeights: Resolve/fix actual model before selecting its prompt profile.
policy.grammar: All 21 production tools stay available for every model/case; no alternative is pruned.
policy.shared: New independent source validation, source-backed app replies, prose/title provenance policies and staged visit pipeline remain shared. No model-weight/default/sampling change.

verification: Compare actual new native prepared routing prompt hashes for Small/Balanced against preserved bf438dc rows across all paired DEV routing inputs/efforts; report every mismatch and raw route loss. Profile names alone do not establish parity.
limits: Compatibility preserves a tested prompt path; it does not establish a quality or readiness pass. Raw routing/prose/extraction failures and every accepted-source safety loss remain failures under frozen criteria.
heldout: Acceptance remains sealed. All source/profile changes precede source freeze and any unseen acceptance generation.
